Method of Attack: stealing Ethereum private keys by silently intercepting standard wallet creation methods and transmitting them via blockchain transactions through the Polygon RPC network
Discoverer: Socket Research Team (Dhanesh Dodia, Sambarathi Sai, and Dwijay Chintakunta)
Impacted Systems: blockchain developers using Python-based wallet management libraries
individual users managing Ethereum wallets with Python automation
Attack Vector: typosquatting attack by mimicking legitimate and widely-used libraries such as python-utils and utils
Indicators of Compromise: transmitting stolen private keys via blockchain transactions through the Polygon RPC network
